description: University Grant Commission - Amendment to the Postgraduate Institute of Agriculture Ordinance.
reasoning: The gazette content is the publication of an ordinance (the Postgraduate Institute of Agriculture (Amendment) Ordinance, No. 03 of 2025) made by the University Grants Commission under the authority of the Universities Act. Its primary purpose is to amend the legal framework governing an academic institute, specifically changing the listed specialities and the composition of Boards of Study. This fits the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes), which includes "New laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations," "Legal amendments," and "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized administrative categories.
